headline: Nobody wants to say that
dek: Without him, the President writes, Israel and the entire Middle East would not exist today. Nobody wants to say it; everybody knows it.

original.speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Israel and, in fact, the entire Middle East, WOULD NOT EXIST TODAY if I did not stop Iran from having a Nuclear Weapon. Nobody wants to say that, but everybody knows it’s true! President DONALD J. TRUMP

verification.note: Copied by the editor from Roll Call Factbase on 7 November 2026.

en: Preventing Iran from obtaining a nuclear weapon has been one of the most important decisions of my presidency. I believe it has made Israel, and the whole Middle East, far safer than it would otherwise be.
History will judge that record. I am confident in how it will judge it.
fr: Empêcher l’Iran de se doter de l’arme nucléaire aura été l’une des décisions les plus importantes de ma présidence. Je suis convaincu qu’elle a rendu Israël, et tout le Moyen-Orient, bien plus sûrs qu’ils ne l’auraient été.
L’Histoire jugera ce bilan. J’ai confiance dans son jugement.
Adieu ! Ici, on sait ce que c’est de tenir une montagne debout. Moi, j’ai tenu tout le Moyen-Orient, alors.
Personne veut le dire, mais tout le monde le sait. C’est comme le meilleur fendant du canton : chacun pense que c’est le sien. Mais c’est le mien.
en: Hello! Up here we know what it takes to keep a mountain standing. I held up the whole Middle East, so there.
Nobody wants to say it, but everybody knows. It’s like the best white wine in the canton: everyone thinks it’s theirs. But it’s mine.

fr: Oh, sans moi, Israël et tout le Moyen-Orient, il en resterait rien, pas même une olive ! Personne veut le dire, mais tout le monde le sait. Même le boulanger, il le sait.
Et je le dis tranquille, hein, sans exagérer. Moi, j’exagère jamais. Demandez à la sardine.
en: Without me, Israel and the whole Middle East, there’d be nothing left, not even an olive! Nobody wants to say it, but everybody knows. Even the baker knows.
And I’m saying it calmly, mind you, no exaggeration. I never exaggerate. Ask the sardine.
notes: The sardine is the one that famously blocked the port of Marseille: the region’s proverbial tall tale.
